items.excerpt: Eddie AI says its purpose-built 9B editing model hit a 47% win rate against Kimi K3 while being small enough to run on-premises, pointing at private, personalized assembly-edit assistants for post houses. Same story also covered by No Film School (nofilmschool.com/eddie-ai-9b) if a different outlet is preferred.

Adobe pushed Firefly's Generate Music, Generate Speech and Generate Sound Effects to general availability, added more third-party AI models and opened Firefly AI Assistant in a free tier. Sound-post relevance: score, VO and SFX generation now sit inside the same tool video editors already use.

Profuz Digital will demo SubtitleNext at IBC with expanded AI transcription integrations across additional speech-to-text engines, IMSCR support, HiDPI and batch subtitle burn-in. A localization/finishing workflow update rather than a generative headline.

ComfyUI shipped an official MCP server, so Claude or Codex can build, run and repair ComfyUI graphs while the filmmaker keeps the creative half. Walks through what agent-driven node graphs mean for a solo AI-video pipeline.

Red Empire Productions and Organic Media Group are developing 'Alishan Escape,' a hybrid-AI Mandopop ghost musical inspired by Taiwan's Ghost Month. A concrete example of AI-assisted production being budgeted into an Asian genre feature rather than a tech demo.

James Gray, who returned to celluloid and vintage tools on 'Paper Tiger,' predicts the industry's 'obscene' AI push will fail and that shooting on film will stage a vinyl-style comeback. A counter-position piece on craft value as generative tooling spreads.

DP Sophie Darlington explains how the patience, imperfection and physical proximity behind Nat Geo's 'Lion' are deliberately positioned against AI-generated wildlife 'slop.' Craft argument for what synthetic footage still cannot fake.
Curious Refuge tests a free AI video generator against paid models and argues the free tier is now good enough for real shot work. Practical cost-floor check for indie AI filmmakers.

Two unannounced video models codenamed 'Polaris' and 'Vega' surfaced in blind testing on the Artificial Analysis arena, with no lab claiming them yet. Includes shot-level comparisons plus a free cinematic reference library for filmmakers.

AI-animation studio Inkrise folds into MetaBull Labs, taking its Felix pipeline tool and deterministic AIR rendering engine with it. MetaBull argues deterministic rendering from layout, storyboard and animation data holds character and narrative continuity that text-to-video models cannot.

American Film Market launches AFM House, home to an Innovation Hub built with Cannes Next that will feature AI startups and emerging production tech alongside the market. Signals where AI tooling gets sold to buyers and financiers this fall.
Brad Pitt says AI, 'used as a tool,' could make more mid-budget films financially viable again — a talent-side framing of generative tooling as a budget lever rather than a replacement for crews.
